name: activated charcoal
uses: Uses • For emergency use to adsorb swallowed poisons.
otcwarn: Warnings • Do not give activated charcoal until after the patient has vomited unless directed by a health professional. • Do not use in persons who are not fully conscious. • Do not use this product, unless directed by a health professional, if turpentine, corrosives (such as alkalies (lye) and strong acids), or petroleum distillates (such as kerosene, gasoline, paint thinner, cleaning fluid or furniture polish), have been ingested.
